changes.what: botShoot() now spawns a real arcing projectile (speed 42, gravity 7, lead + lift) when a projectile pool is supplied; hitscan traceShot remains only as a fallback for callers without one.
changes.why: Director: bots hitscan-sniped at range while players lobbed dodgeable arcs. Bots now play by the same rules.

changes.what: spawn() carries an ownerBot reference on the pooled item.
changes.why: Locally simulated bots need to report their own projectile hits to the server.

changes.what: Passes this.projectiles into the bot brain ctx; _onProjectileHit reports bot-owned hits via item.ownerBot.netId; new _deflect() batting hostile arcs back (owner/team flipped, damage x1.25, speed x1.15) while guarding; RMB guard wired for the leafblade; charge value now carries across _swapWeapon (shared Focus); control hint updated.
changes.why: Duel Triangle: guard makes the saber answer projectiles; carrying charge over kills the Q-swap free-ammo exploit.

changes.what: guardArc/guardRange constants, guarding state + blended flat guard pose, guard blocked mid-swing and swings blocked while guarding.
changes.why: Guard must be a readable commitment with a real opportunity cost, not a free toggle.

directives_done: Kill bot hitscan — bots fire dodgeable projectiles
Duel Triangle — RMB saber guard deflects projectiles back at their owner
Shared Focus — charge carries across weapon swaps
